decision.reason: [ev-4851b37425c0] bundles two separate removals from the Strimzi container images: the EnvVar Configuration Provider and the MirrorMaker 2 Extensions. They have different replacements (Apache Kafka EnvVarConfigProvider and Identity Replication Policy), so no single subject, change or applicability condition covers both. The excerpt also does not say what happens to an environment whose configuration still references a removed plugin class, so the consequence cannot be typed. The change should be split into one item per plugin, with evidence (for example the linked deprecation notices) that states the plugin class names and what happens when a configuration still uses them.
